comments.body: Thanks for the follow-up! Title Lint caps titles at 80 characters — could you shorten it a bit (e.g. `fix(syncer): resolve Kind via API discovery`)? Happy to review once that goes green.

Thanks! The title is now `fix(syncer): use the discovered Kind instead of trimming the plural name` (72 characters, under the 80 limit), and Title Lint, Golang Lint, Unit Test, License Check and CLA are green on the current head. Ready for your review whenever you have time.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
